entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, hello? I... I think I need to return something. It's all so confusing.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?
Umm, let me see... I have the email here. It's VF886-21-B. I hope that's right. I'm just not very good with this stuff.
Thank you, I've got the order pulled up now. I see the Aero Pro cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?

They just... they hurt. I tried them on a ride and they gave me terrible blisters. And I can't seem to get the cleats positioned right. I looked at the website, and the policies... I just don't understand it. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help. It sounds like the fit isn't right for you, which can definitely be an issue with new cycling shoes. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Oh, thank you. I was worried it was too late. I've had them for... a little over a month, I think.
Okay, one moment. *[keyboard typing]* Alright, I can see the order was delivered 41 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send them back?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the window. I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending you a prepaid shipping label to your email on file now. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the shoes, we will process a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's... that's so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, David. You've been a great help.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
